title: Gathering
description: Possible gathering locations from the game's own map data, on the original world maps, with your position while capture knows it. They are places a node can appear, not sightings.
source: From the game's own map data. These are places a node can appear: whether one is there now, when it returns and what it takes to gather are not known.
